name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Canadian mineral exploration and development company advancing its Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 outlining a fully permitted, large-scale development with a US$3.0B after-tax NPV and 20.3 million oz AgEq production in the first five years. AbraSilver is targeting first production in 2029, placing it in the developer stage.
